title.narrative: Higher Education Quality and Innovation Project

description.narrative: The project will support enhancements to the higher education system through improvements to program content, delivery system and research and innovation capacity. The project will support (i) strengthening research and innovation capacity for increased relevance and international recognition, (ii) academic transformations that include course redesign using an integrated teaching and research approach, and (iii) strengthening governance and management of higher education. The project will support improved learning and realizing the value of dual education (academic and applied) in teaching and learning. This will include developing learning modules/activities, upskilling activities, collaborations on content development, coaching programs and introduction of post COVID learning recovery measures; supporting the implementation of internal and external quality assurance and improvements; support innovations and research, professional development of teaching and research staff. The end goal is improved relevance, competitiveness and visibility of higher education institutions in the Kyrgyz Republic.
To improve the quality of research and strengthen the quality and labor market alignment of higher education programs
